---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that ConnectBot doesn't support today? Describe the
use case, not just the missing feature.

## Proposed solution

How you think it could work. If it touches the widget (`public/relay.js`),
keep in mind it must stay dependency-free ES5.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using now, or other approaches you rejected.
